accepted.expected_invariant: API health endpoint returns 200 and mock workflow completes successfully after pod restart.
accepted.hypothesis: The API service has a healthcheck and restart policy, but no replica count. A single pod kill may cause a brief downtime window during restart, and if the healthcheck is not properly configured, the service may not be marked ready, leading to failed requests.
accepted.recovery_expectation: API should restart automatically and become healthy within a short time; no persistent failure.
accepted.validation_plan: Baseline: verify API health and mock workflow. Inject pod_kill on api. Observe API availability and healthcheck status. Check oracle: API health and mock workflow response.
accepted.weakness_surface: API service availability and healthcheck readiness
accepted.workload_contract: API readiness plus mock workflow response

accepted.expected_invariant: API mock workflow that uses agent_backend should complete successfully after agent_backend restart.
accepted.hypothesis: agent_backend has no healthcheck and depends on plugin_daemon and redis. A pod kill may cause the API to fail requests that depend on agent_backend, and without a healthcheck, the service may not be detected as unhealthy, leading to prolonged downtime.
accepted.recovery_expectation: agent_backend should restart automatically and recover; API may experience transient errors but should recover.
accepted.validation_plan: Baseline: verify API mock workflow. Inject pod_kill on agent_backend. Observe API responses and agent_backend restart. Check oracle: mock workflow response.
accepted.weakness_surface: agent_backend availability and lack of healthcheck
accepted.workload_contract: API readiness plus mock workflow response

accepted.recovery_expectation: Redis should restart automatically; API may experience transient errors but should recover.
accepted.validation_plan: Baseline: verify API health and mock workflow. Inject pod_kill on redis. Observe API responses and Redis restart. Check oracle: API health and mock workflow.
accepted.workload_contract: API readiness plus mock workflow response
